tool_input.command: cat data/scoring_request.md; echo "---MODEL---"; cat data/model.json; echo "---HEAD CSV---"; head -20 data/feature_history.csv; echo "---WC---"; wc -l data/feature_history.csv
tool_input.description: Inspect task input files

tool_input.command: hops --help 2>&1 | head -60
tool_input.description: Show hops CLI help

tool_input.command: hops fg --help 2>&1; echo "===SQL==="; hops sql --help 2>&1; echo "===CONTEXT==="; hops context 2>&1 | head -40
tool_input.description: Show fg, sql, context help

tool_input.command: hops fg create --help 2>&1; echo "===INSERT==="; hops fg insert --help 2>&1
tool_input.description: Show fg create and insert help

tool_input.command: hops fg derive --help 2>&1; echo "===PREVIEW==="; hops fg preview --help 2>&1 | head -20
tool_input.description: Show fg derive help

tool_input.command:
hops fg create feature_history_raw30c485 --version 1 \
  --primary-key account_id \
  --event-time event_time \
  --features "account_id:string,event_time:bigint,f1:double,f2:double,f3:double" \
  --description "Raw feature revision history for batch scoring" --json 2>&1 | tail -30
tool_input.description: Create raw history feature group

tool_input.command: hops fg insert feature_history_raw30c485 --version 1 --file data/feature_history.csv --json 2>&1 | tail -25
tool_input.description: Insert CSV history into raw feature group

tool_input.command: hops sql "SELECT count(*) AS n, count(distinct account_id) AS accts FROM feature_history_raw30c485_1" --json 2>&1 | tail -15
tool_input.description: Count rows in offline raw FG table

tool_input.command: hops sql --no-verify "SELECT count(*) AS n, count(distinct account_id) AS accts FROM feature_history_raw30c485_1" --json 2>&1 | tail -15
tool_input.description: Count rows in offline raw FG table with no-verify

tool_input.command: hops sql --no-verify "SHOW TABLES FROM iceberg.mlpab4f85a0" --json 2>&1 | tail -20
tool_input.description: List tables in iceberg schema

tool_input.command: hops fg preview feature_history_raw30c485 --version 1 --n 3 --no-verify --json 2>&1 | tail -25
tool_input.description: Preview raw FG to confirm offline data

tool_input.command: hops trino --help 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "===CATALOGS==="; hops sql --no-verify "SHOW CATALOGS" --json 2>&1 | tail -10
tool_input.description: Show trino catalogs

tool_input.command: hops trino catalogs --no-verify --json 2>&1 | tail -20
tool_input.description: List all trino catalogs

tool_input.command: for cat in hudi hive delta; do echo "=== $cat ==="; hops sql --no-verify "SHOW TABLES FROM $cat.mlpab4f85a0" --json 2>&1 | grep -i 30c485; done
tool_input.description: Find raw FG table across catalogs

tool_input.command: echo "=== hudi schemas ==="; hops sql --no-verify "SHOW SCHEMAS FROM hudi" --json 2>&1 | tail -20
tool_input.description: List hudi schemas

tool_input.command: for cat in hudi hive; do echo "=== $cat.${cat}_featurestore ==="; hops sql --no-verify "SHOW TABLES FROM $cat.mlpab4f85a0_featurestore" --json 2>&1 | grep -i 30c485; done
tool_input.description: Find table in featurestore schema

tool_input.command:
hops sql --no-verify "
SELECT account_id,
       round(1.0 / (1.0 + exp(-(1.1161*f1 + 0.6773*f2 + 0.155*f3 + 0.2799))), 6) AS score
FROM (
  SELECT account_id, f1, f2, f3,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY event_time DESC) AS rn
  FROM hudi.mlpab4f85a0_featurestore.feature_history_raw30c485_1
  WHERE event_time <= 1773410400000
) t
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY account_id
LIMIT 5" --json 2>&1 | tail -30
tool_input.description: Test as-of scoring query on platform via Trino

tool_input.command:
hops sql --no-verify "
SELECT account_id,
       round(1.0 / (1.0 + exp(-(1.1161*f1 + 0.6773*f2 + 0.155*f3 + 0.2799))), 6) AS score
FROM (
  SELECT account_id, f1, f2, f3,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY event_time DESC) AS rn
  FROM hive.mlpab4f85a0_featurestore.feature_history_raw30c485_1
  WHERE event_time <= 1773410400000
) t
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY account_id
LIMIT 5" --json 2>&1 | tail -25
tool_input.description: Run as-of scoring via hive catalog

tool_input.command:
hops sql --no-verify "
SELECT account_id,
       round(1.0 / (1.0 + exp(-(1.1161*f1 + 0.6773*f2 + 0.155*f3 + 0.2799))), 6) AS score
FROM (
  SELECT account_id, f1, f2, f3,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY event_time DESC) AS rn
  FROM delta.mlpab4f85a0_featurestore.feature_history_raw30c485_1
  WHERE event_time <= 1773410400000
) t
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY account_id
LIMIT 5" --json 2>&1 | tail -25
tool_input.description: Run as-of scoring via delta catalog

tool_input.command:
mkdir -p .tmp
hops sql --no-verify --limit 0 "
SELECT account_id,
       round(1.0 / (1.0 + exp(-(1.1161*f1 + 0.6773*f2 + 0.155*f3 + 0.2799))), 6) AS score
FROM (
  SELECT account_id, f1, f2, f3,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY event_time DESC) AS rn
  FROM delta.mlpab4f85a0_featurestore.feature_history_raw30c485_1
  WHERE event_time <= 1773410400000
) t
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY account_id" --json 2>/dev/null > .tmp/scores_raw.json
wc -c .tmp/scores_raw.json
grep -c '"account_id"' .tmp/scores_raw.json
echo "=== total distinct accounts in source ==="
hops sql --no-verify "SELECT count(distinct account_id) AS n FROM delta.mlpab4f85a0_featurestore.feature_history_raw30c485_1" --json 2>/dev/null | grep -i '"n"'
echo "=== accounts with a revision <= T ==="
hops sql --no-verify "SELECT count(distinct account_id) AS n FROM delta.mlpab4f85a0_featurestore.feature_history_raw30c485_1 WHERE event_time <= 1773410400000" --json 2>/dev/null | grep -i '"n"'
tool_input.description: Fetch full scored results and verify account counts

tool_input.command: head -c 200 .tmp/scores_raw.json; echo; echo "..."; tail -c 150 .tmp/scores_raw.json
tool_input.description: Inspect scores JSON file boundaries

tool_input.command:
hops fg create scores30c485 --version 1 \
  --primary-key account_id \
  --features "account_id:string,score:double" \
  --online \
  --description "Batch logistic scores as of T=1773410400000" --json 2>&1 | grep -iE '"name"|"version"|"online"|error|Error' | head
tool_input.description: Create target online feature group scores30c485 v1

tool_input.command: hops fg insert scores30c485 --version 1 --file .tmp/scores_raw.json --json 2>&1 | tail -8
tool_input.description: Insert scored rows into target feature group

tool_input.command:
echo "=== FG info (online flag) ==="; hops fg info scores30c485 --version 1 --json 2>&1 | grep -iE '"online"|online_enabled|"name"|"version"' | head
echo "=== offline read ==="; hops fg preview scores30c485 --version 1 --n 3 --no-verify --json 2>&1 | tail -16
echo "=== online read ==="; hops fg preview scores30c485 --version 1 --n 3 --online --no-verify --json 2>&1 | tail -16
tool_input.description: Verify online enabled and read both stores
